chronology: Development and first test freezes preserved. Later evidence, thinking, sampling and citation ablations are adaptive and labeled post-hoc where applicable.
metric_contract: correct requires a valid structured output and legal nonempty evidence IDs. raw_decision_correct in citation reports separately ignores citation failures.
publication_boundary: Official full documents, extracted source inputs, full source-derived model responses and existing customer deliverables excluded. Source locators, hashes, authored probes, selected output fields and code included.
runtime_counter_limit: API eval_count does not reliably cover the complete thinking field. Reported counts are preserved but not treated as total token cost.
scope: Independent personal Korean policy claim, evidence and applicability research; AI-assisted design, coding and provisional references.
